goal: Speed up `links_finish` in src/dict.c. It runs on worker 0 during the event parse, costs ~113 ms of CPU at 20M events, and runs at IPC 0.27 (memory-bound). perf attributes ~38% of its time to the final loop `lb->slots[lb->dslot[i]].val = lb->dkey[aux[dsu_find(parent, i)]]` (random writes into a 38 MB LookupEntry table) and ~36% to the smallest-name loop (random reads of lb->dkey[aux[r]]). Reduce the cache-miss stalls, e.g. by software-prefetching (__builtin_prefetch) the slot / dkey entries several iterations ahead, or by restructuring a loop so independent misses overlap. Results must be identical.
hints: dsu_find does path halving and writes parent[]; keep the union order exactly as is (it decides component roots only, not names, but keep it simple).
A prefetch distance of 8-32 iterations is typical for DRAM latency at this loop's work per iteration.
The smallest-name rule (bytes_cmp, shorter prefix first) must not change.
